SELECT
  s.installs AS payment_installments,
  COALESCE(agg.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM
  generate_series(1, 5) AS s(installs)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) AS payment_installments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM
    order_payments op
  WHERE
    op.payment_installments BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0)
) agg
  ON s.installs = agg.payment_installments
ORDER BY
  s.installs;
